name: Survey tile in Sagittarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Sagittarius, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 26 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 16 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 26 hours starting 2025-10-04, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.39 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
